children: said on Monday it would acquire Range Resources
in an all-stock deal valued at more than $50 billion, creating what the companies called the largest vertically integrated natural gas producer in the United States.
Under the terms of the deal, Range shareholders will receive 0.987 shares of EQT stock for each share held.

EQT shareholders will own about 73% of the combined company, while Range investors will hold the remaining 27%. The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals.
